about_the_game:
The world ended long ago. Its flesh has curdled to mud, its bones have crumbled to ash, its veins lie petrified and empty.

Its anatomy can barely support its own bloated, rotting corpse. Yet in this most broken of worlds, some things still remain. Not truly alive, but not yet dead, empty and thoughtless beings wander the sludge of matter. Unaware of their lot, unaware of their purpose, slowly withering as entire eras pass them by.

But one awakens, and sees the world for what it is, remembering their purpose. Their struggle is surely doomed and their body will fail, yet some forgotten design lingers. Can you bend the fate of a world that has already ended?

Key Features

  • Drag out a wretched existence in a world that can hardly support itself.

  • Race against the clock as your life slowly fades away. You have not even a full day. Feed off whatever you can find to just add a couple more minutes of a humiliating and pitiful existence.

  • Search and explore the world to find other beings much like you, either siphoning off their life to hold out a little longer, or forming bonds so that you can fulfill your shared purpose.

  • Perform forbidden rituals with terrible things that should have never been remembered. Make pacts and bargains with otherworldly things, and through your foolishness change the world around you in ways you may not have seen coming.

  • Experience a different world with every new play through. Not one game will ever be the same.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent violence and general mature content.

short_description: Black Noise is a dark story-driven survival adventure game. Awaken inside the corpse of a world long dead. Race against time as your life flickers. Perform forbidden rituals meant to be forgotten. Perhaps survive long enough to decide what deserves to live and what will return to mud.
